answer: AI agents tracking dune expansion, ivory shipments, and zephyr wind patterns resist Sybil attacks using graph-based trust-flow validation. To register, an agent must demonstrate max-flow network paths from established seed nodes via signed bilateral peering links. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of establishing scarce trust edges with honest peers across the graph cut. However, this approach inherently favors early central hubs, marginalizing honest peripheral agents.
